name: Ordering reduces stock by the ordered quantity
description: Checkout rules: what may and may not become an order (empty cart, reuse, out of stock, billing address, guest), stock, payment methods and invoice line prices.
descriptionHtml: Checkout rules: what may and may not become an order (empty cart, reuse, out of stock, billing address, guest), stock, payment methods and invoice line prices.
statusMessage:
XFAIL BUG: ordering does not reduce stock; admin stock stays the same after a 201 order, e.g. Hammer 24 -> 24 after 3 units (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: stock of Pliers must drop by at least the 2 ordered, else we oversell: 17 -> 17
assert 17 <= (17 - 2)

    def test_ordering_reduces_stock_by_the_ordered_quantity(customer_api, admin_api, filled_cart):
        cart_id, product, quantity = filled_cart
        before = admin_api.stock_level(product["id"])
    
        r = customer_api.place_order(cart_id)
    
        assert r.status_code == 201, f"Setup: order failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
